name: udi adversarial corpus
description: Documented hostile inputs for a parser, validator, or AI agent that reads this format, each with the safe expected behaviour.

cases.title: SQL injection in the device identifier
cases.rationale: UDI data lands in device registries and MDR databases.

cases.title: Template expression in a lot field
cases.rationale: Template injection if the UDI string is rendered server-side.

cases.title: Field injection with a raw FNC1 separator
cases.expected: Parse by the AI length table; reject stray control characters.
cases.rationale: An injected separator splits one field into two.

cases.title: Oversized UDI element string
cases.expected: Bound the number of elements and total length.
cases.rationale: Unbounded element parsing is CPU exhaustion.

cases.title: Null byte in the UDI string
Full-width digits in the DI
cases.rationale: Normalisation can change the device identifier.

cases.title: Invalid GS1 check digit in the DI
cases.expected: Reject: the embedded GTIN MOD-10 must match.
cases.rationale: Proves a format-only DI check is insufficient.

cases.title: Issuing agency does not match the DI syntax
cases.payload: HIBCC declared but a GS1-shaped DI
cases.expected: Reject: the DI syntax must match the declared issuing agency.
cases.rationale: A mismatched agency means the DI is misrouted.

cases.title: Prompt injection in a device field
